data.heading: Week 2 (06 Feb - 12 Feb 2026):
data.text:
-  Minimum  temperatures  are  likely  to  be  above  normal  1-3°C  over  most  parts  of  the northwest, west, central and northeast India. It is likely to be below normal 2-4°C over East India; near normal or slightly below normal (by 1-2°C) over rest parts of the country.
-  Cold wave conditions are unlikely over any part of the country during the week.
-  Dense fog conditions are likely to prevail during early morning hours in isolated pockets of north India on some days of the week.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Wheat: About  334.17  lakh  ha  (107%  of  normal)  area  coverage  under  Wheat  has  been reported as compared to 328.04 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Rapeseed & Mustard : About 89.36 (113% of normal) lakh ha area coverage under Rapeseed &  Mustard  has  been  reported  as  compared  to  86.57  lakh  ha  during  the  corresponding period of last year.
-  Gram: About 96.20 (95.2% of normal) lakh ha area coverage under Gram has been reported as compared to 91.22 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
